scope: TPs whose IUT is a PKI entity: EA (53), AA (53), Root CA (34), common CA (22), TLM (16), DC (2), CPOC (1)
reason: They test a PKI (certificate issuance, CTL/CRL/ECTL generation and distribution), not an ITS station; the stacks contain only the ITS-S side. They are run against pythonpki, which speaks the official ETSI TS 102 941 V2.2.1 messages: one test per TP in pythonpki/tests/conformance, results in pythonpki/tests/conformance/traceability.md (171 run: 167 pass, 4 not applicable (implicit certificates); 10 butterfly TPs, optional, not implemented).

scope: Access-layer DCC (channel congestion control in the 5,9 GHz range): single transceiver (12), multiple transceivers (32), G5B spectrum (29)
reason: They test the access-layer DCC of ETSI TS 102 687 V1.1.1: a Relaxed/Active/Restrictive state machine per channel, per-DCC-profile queues with Toff, transmit power limits and status reports at the radio interface, observed on the air. These stacks implement a different DCC: the reactive and adaptive algorithms of ETSI TS 102 687 V1.2.1 in the management layer, driving the CAM / VAM generation interval, and DCC_NET of ETSI TS 103 836-4-2; their unit tests are listed under 'DCC' in traceability.md. No TSS&TP for them was available. Not ported by decision.
